content: चर् €1 <ab>P.</ab> (चरति, चचार, अचारीत्, चरितुम्, चरित or sometimes चीर्णं) .²1 To walk, move, go about, roam, wander; नष्टाशङ्का हरिणशिशवो मन्दमन्दं चरन्ति <ls>Ś. 1. 15</ls> (चर् may mean here-- ‘to graze’ also); इन्द्रियाणां हि चरताम् <ls>Bg. 2. 67</ls>; कपयश्चेरुरार्तस्य रामस्येव मनोरथाः <ls>R. 12. 59</ls>; <ls>Ms. 2. 23</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">6. 68</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">8. 236</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">9. 306</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">10. 55</ls>. .²2 .³({%a%}) To perform, do, act; रचयति रेखाः सलिले यस्तु खले चरति सत्कारम् <ls>Bv. 1. 98</ls>. .³({%b%}) To practise, perform, observe; चरतः किल दुश्चरं तपः <ls>R. 8. 79</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 60</ls>; <ls>Ms. 3. 30</ls>. .²3 To act, behave towards, conduct oneself (<ab>oft.</ab> with <ab>loc.</ab> of the person); चरतीनां च कामतः <ls>Ms. 5. 90</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">9. 287</ls>; आत्मवत्सर्वभूतेषु यश्चरेत् <ls>Mb.</ls>; तस्यां त्वं साधु नाचरः <ls>R. 1. 76</ls> (where the root may be also आचर्). .²4 To graze; सुचिरं हि चरन् शस्यम् <ls>H. 3. 9</ls>. .²5 To eat, consume. .²6 To be engaged in, be busy with. .²7 To live, continue to be, continue in any state. .²8 To spread, be diffused. .²9 To live, be, exist. .²10 To move, travel through, pervade, go along, follow. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (चारयति) .²1 To cause to move or go. .²2 To send, direct, move. .²3 To drive away. .²4 To cause to perform or practise. .²5 To cause to copulate. .²6 To cause to graze, pasture. .²7 To obtain knowledge of, acquaint oneself with. .²8 To doubt. [<ab>cf.</ab> <lang>L.</lang> {%curro%}.]
